title: Tesla Fremont Flyover Gigapress Operation Captured - Jan 21, 2021
summary: Drone footage over Tesla's Fremont factory in January 2021 that captures a Gigapress die-casting machine in operation.
why: HN commenters cite it as a rare look at Tesla's giant casting presses in action during discussions of mega-castings.
